correctness.rationale: The pooled spacing statistic is independent Gamma with shape k(n-1). On the one-versus-rest ray, selection reduces to one exponential variable competing with the maximum of k-1 iid exponentials. The resulting excess expectation has the finite expansion H_{k-1}(t). Substitution into the exact quadratic risk for Z-cS gives the stated difference. H_{k-1}(t)=E[D 1{D>t}] has derivative -t f_D(t)<0, so the threshold is unique. The packaged verifier independently checks the excess expectation by quadrature and replays the risk algebra.
